params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Tahm Kench}} {{tip|basic attacks}} and ''{{ai|Tongue Lash|Tahm Kench}}'' deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} based on {{as|his '''bonus''' health}}, and apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''An Acquired Taste'' against {{tip|champions}} that stacks up to a cap.
params.blurb2: ''{{ai|Tongue Lash|Tahm Kench}}'' and ''{{ai|Devour|Tahm Kench}}'' gain additional effects against enemies with max stacks, consuming them all.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Tahm Kench's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and ''{{ai|Tongue Lash|Tahm Kench}}'' are empowered to deal {{as|{{pp|5 to 60 for 12}}|magic damage}} ({{as|+ {{fd|1.25}}% AP}} {{as|per 100 '''bonus''' health}}) {{as|(+ 4% of his '''bonus''' health)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''An Acquired Taste'' against enemy {{tip|champions}} for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 3 times. Stacks expire one by one every {{fd|0.67}} seconds when the duration ends.
params.description2: ''{{ai|Tongue Lash|Tahm Kench}}'' and ''{{ai|Devour|Tahm Kench}}'' gain additional effects against enemies with 3 stacks, consuming them all.
params.notes:
* The passive bonus damage applies to turrets.
* When ''An Acquired Taste'' is applied by {{ai|Tongue Lash|Tahm Kench}}, the damage is dealt as an '''additional''' instance of damage (as opposed to '''bonus''' damage when applied by basic attacks).
** This causes effects like {{ri|Bone Plating}} and {{iis|Bloodletter's Curse}} {{nie|Vile Decay}} to be applied twice.

params.notes:
* '''Tongue Lash's''' range and speed scale 1:1 alongside any {{tip|size}} modifiers to '''Tahm Kench''', but will not be reduced ''below'' their base values if his overall size modifier is smaller than 100%.
** As the missile range and speed scale simultaneously, '''Tongue Lash''' will always take {{rutngt|0.321429}} to reach its maximum range (no matter the cast range).
** Because of this, increasing '''Tahm Kench's''' size with items such as {{ii|Elixir of Iron}} allows him to hit targets at even the same distance more quickly and giving them less time to dodge.
* {{ai|Devour|Tahm Kench}} can be 'queued' at any point during ''Tongue Lash'' (including the wind-up animation) and will not go on cooldown if '''Tahm Kench''' fails to hit a valid target with ''Tongue Lash''.
* All three {{ai|An Acquired Taste|Tahm Kench}} stacks will be consumed even if ''Tongue Lash's'' {{tip|stun}} is negated.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} {{ci|Tahm Kench}} stores [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] equal to a portion of damage taken, increased while he is near at least 2 enemy champions.
params.blurb2: While ''Thick Skin'' is off cooldown, and after a few seconds without taking damage, '''Tahm Kench''' rapidly consumes his grey health to {{tip|heal}} up to a portion.
params.blurb3: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Tahm Kench''' converts his grey health into a {{tip|shield}} that lasts a short time.
params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Tahm Kench''' stores a portion of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} he takes as [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] on his [[health bar]], increased while there are at least 2 nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy champions either dead or alive. He can store up to {{as|300% of his '''maximum''' health}}.
params.leveling:
{{st|Damage Stored into Grey Health|{{ap|15 to 47}}%}}
{{st|Increased Damage Stored into Grey Health|{{ap|42 to 50}}%}}
params.description2: While ''Thick Skin'' is not on cooldown, and after 4 seconds without taking damage, '''Tahm Kench''' rapidly consumes his [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] to restore {{pp|key=%|60 to 100}} of the amount, {{tip|healing}} for {{as|10% of his '''maximum''' health}} every {{rutngt|0.25}}.
params.description3: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Tahm Kench''' converts his current [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] into a {{tip|shield}} that lasts for {{fd|2.5}} seconds.
params.notes:
* ''Thick Skin'' shield value and ''grey health'' percentage heal are both boosted by effects that increase heal and shield power. This means '''Tahm Kench''' can technically heal more than the normal amount of ''grey health'' and get a shield bigger than his maximum health.
** At level 18 '''Tahm Kench''' would need {{ap|(1/0.65-1)*100|round=1}}% {{sti|heal power}} to heal for 100% of the damage he takes, reduced to {{ap|(1/(0.65*1.1)-1.05)*100|round=1}}% with {{ri|Revitalize}}, {{ap|(1/(0.65*1.25)-1)*100|round=1}}% with {{ii|Spirit Visage}}, and {{ap|(1/(0.65*1.1*1.25)-1.05)*100|round=1}}% with both.
* ''Grey health'' converts all post-mitigation damage, ''Thick Skin'' effectively grants ''Tahm Kench'' a form of {{as|true damage}} mitigation.
* ''Grey health'' can temporarily exceed 100% of his missing health when '''Tahm Kench''' {{tt|heals through other means|Any other source of healing besides Thick Skin}} with a ''grey health'' bar at 100%. In that case he will keep the higher ''grey health'' value for a few moments until it updates and removes the amount that he healed.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Tahm Kench}} swallows the target {{tip|champion}} for a short time, {{tip|vanish|vanishing}} them. ''Devour'' can only be cast on enemies with 3 stacks of ''{{ai|An Acquired Taste|Tahm Kench}}''.
params.blurb2: If the target is an ally, they are granted a {{tip|shield}} that lasts a short time. '''Tahm Kench''' will also gain {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for a short time, but cannot cast movement spells besides ''{{ai|Abyssal Dive|Tahm Kench}}'' while an ally is swallowed.
params.blurb3: '''Tahm Kench''' can cast ''{{ai|Regurgitate|Tahm Kench}}'' within the duration, and automatically does so afterwards. The swallowed ally can also force this cast by attempting to exit in the target direction.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|{{ai|An Acquired Taste|Tahm Kench}} Bonus:}} The target is {{tip|suppression|suppressed}} while swallowed. '''Tahm Kench''' will also be {{tip|grounded}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}} while an enemy is swallowed.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Tahm Kench''' abducts the target {{tip|champion}}, {{tt|pulling them|See notes}} to him over the cast time and then swallowing them to carry them in his belly for up to 3 seconds. While inside, the target is {{tip|attach|attached}} to '''Tahm Kench''' and is rendered {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|displacement immune}}. ''Devour'' can only be cast on enemies with 3 stacks of ''{{ai|An Acquired Taste|Tahm Kench}}''.
params.description2: If the target is an ally, they become {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} and are granted a {{tip|shield}}, which decays in strength by 50 every {{fd|0.25}} seconds after they are ''{{ai|Regurgitate|Tahm Kench|Regurgitated}}''. '''Tahm Kench''' will also gain {{sti|{{as|60% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 3 seconds and is unable to cast movement spells besides ''{{ai|Abyssal Dive|Tahm Kench}}'' while an ally is inside of his belly.
params.description3: After 1 second, '''Tahm Kench''' can cast ''{{ai|Regurgitate|Tahm Kench}}'' while a target is inside of his belly, and automatically does so after the duration. The swallowed ally can also {{tt|input a movement command|RMB}} to force '''Tahm Kench''' to cast ''{{ai|Regurgitate|Tahm Kench}}'' in a target direction of their choice, unless they are {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}.
params.description4: {{sbc|{{ai|An Acquired Taste|Tahm Kench}} Bonus:}} The target is {{tip|suppression|suppressed}} during ''Devour's'' cast time and while attached. '''Tahm Kench''' will also be {{tip|grounded}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 40% under those same conditions.
params.description5: ''If '''Tahm Kench''' is performing {{ai|Abyssal Dive|Tahm Kench}}, {{ai|Regurgitate|Tahm Kench}} will not automatically cast until after he finishes {{ais|Abyssal Dive|Tahm Kench}} effects.''
params.cdstart: Starts post-effect, but time spent active will be reduced by current cooldown afterwards
params.notes:
* ''Devour's'' initial pull is a non-{{tip|airborne}} displacement that displaces the target toward '''Tahm Kench''' over the ability's cast time.
** This is also the same displacement that is used for when ''Devour'' is cast with ''{{ai|Tongue Lash|Tahm Kench}}'', though with a greater pull distance as well as faster pull speed to account for ''Devour's'' short cast time.
** The target will {{tip|blink}} to '''Tahm Kench's''' location at the end of this displacement, including if it is interrupted.
* The {{tip|untargetability}} and {{tip|displacement immunity}} is granted to the target during ''Devour's'' cast time as well.
* Against enemies, ''Devour's'' pull from abducting the target depends on the application of the {{tip|suppression}}; if the suppression is not applied, neither is the pull. Similarly, if the suppression is removed, the displacement from the pull plus the {{tip|untargetability}} and {{tip|displacement immunity}} are instantly stopped.
** The attachment also depends upon the occurrence of the pull; if the target is not pulled, they are not attached to '''Tahm Kench''' and the swallow fails, cancelling the ability entirely.
** If the target resists the suppression by being {{tip|cc-immune|immune to crowd control}}, {{tip|displacement immune}}, or having a {{tip|spell shield}}, '''Tahm Kench''' will not pull the target towards him.
** If the suppression was removed while the target is attached to '''Tahm Kench''' (in other words, inside of his belly), the target will detach themselves from him instantly without '''Tahm Kench''' performing ''{{ai|Regurgitate|Tahm Kench}}''.
* ''Devour's'' suppression against enemies is removed if '''Tahm Kench''' dies, enters {{tip|resurrection}}, or transitions in or out of the {{ai|Realm of Death|Mordekaiser|Death Realm}}.
* {{iis|Experimental Hexplate}} {{nie|Overdrive}}, {{iis|Fiendhunter Bolts}} {{nie|Opening Barrage}}, and {{iis|Zeke's Convergence}} {{nie|Frostfire Tempest}} trigger after ''Devour's'' suppression ends or after ''{{ais|Regurgitate|Tahm Kench}}'' displacement, if ''Regurgitate'' is cast.
* Enemies will be dealt ''{{ais|Regurgitate|Tahm Kench}}'' damage regardless of '''Tahm Kench''' casting the ability if ''Devour's'' suppression ends by any means other than {{ai|Skaarl the Cowardly Lizard 2|Kled|dismounting}}{{bug}} (including during ''Devour's'' cast time).
* If the target enters {{tip|resurrection}}, or they are a {{ci|Mordekaiser}} that transitions into a different {{ai|Realm of Death|Mordekaiser|dimension}} from '''Tahm Kench''', he will ''{{ai|Regurgitate|Tahm Kench}}'' them automatically.
* ''Devour'' cannot be used on allies that are {{tip|channel|channeling}} or using an ability that preloads {{tip|unstoppableforcemarker|UnstoppableForceMarker}}.
* The {{tip|slow|self-slow}} is affected by {{tip|slow resist}}.
* '''Tahm Kench''' cannot use {{tip|gates}} during ''Devour''.
* Allies can see if this spell is ready next to '''Tahm Kench's''' health bar.
* The swallowed target is not considered to be {{tip|vanish|vanished}}. They are instead hidden below the visible map plane, to maintain ongoing effects such as {{cai|Curse of the Black Mist|Senna}}.
* During ''Devour's'' attachment and {{ais|Regurgitate|Tahm Kench}} displacement, the swallowed target's camera is locked and centered on their champion.
** This does not affect '''Tahm Kench'''.
* ''Devour's'' self {{tip|ground}} can be cleansed by {{cai|R|Milio}}.{{bug}}
* The following table refers for interactions while the target is unable to act:
{{ct|attack=false|move=If an ally, forces '''Tahm Kench''' to use ''{{ai|Regurgitate|Tahm Kench}}'' unless movement commands are otherwise restricted. If an enemy, movement commands are disabled.|cast=false|items=false|consume=false|spells=false|interrupts=death}}
{{ct|cast|items=false|consume=false|spells=true,false,false,false,false}}

blurb.plain: Active: Tahm Kench swallows the target champion for a short time, vanishing them. Devour can only be cast on enemies with 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste.

blurb2.plain: If the target is an ally, they are granted a shield that lasts a short time. Tahm Kench will also gain bonus movement speed for a short time, but cannot cast movement spells besides Abyssal Dive while an ally is swallowed.

blurb3.plain: Tahm Kench can cast Regurgitate within the duration, and automatically does so afterwards. The swallowed ally can also force this cast by attempting to exit in the target direction.

blurb4.plain: An Acquired Taste Bonus: The target is suppressed while swallowed. Tahm Kench will also be grounded and slowed while an enemy is swallowed.

description.plain: Active: Tahm Kench abducts the target champion, pulling them to him over the cast time and then swallowing them to carry them in his belly for up to 3 seconds. While inside, the target is attached to Tahm Kench and is rendered untargetable and displacement immune. Devour can only be cast on enemies with 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste.

description2.plain: If the target is an ally, they become unable to act and are granted a shield, which decays in strength by 50 every 0.25 seconds after they are Regurgitated. Tahm Kench will also gain 60% bonus movement speed for 3 seconds and is unable to cast movement spells besides Abyssal Dive while an ally is inside of his belly.

description3.plain: After 1 second, Tahm Kench can cast Regurgitate while a target is inside of his belly, and automatically does so after the duration. The swallowed ally can also input a movement command to force Tahm Kench to cast Regurgitate in a target direction of their choice, unless they are immobilized.

description4.plain: An Acquired Taste Bonus: The target is suppressed during Devour's cast time and while attached. Tahm Kench will also be grounded and slowed by 40% under those same conditions.

description5.plain: If Tahm Kench is performing Abyssal Dive, Regurgitate will not automatically cast until after he finishes Abyssal Dive effects.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Tahm Kench''' {{tip|airborne|spits}} the swallowed champion in the target direction. If they are an enemy, he deals {{as|magic damage}} based on the {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Tahm Kench''' detaches the swallowed champion from himself and {{tip|airborne|spits}} them out in the target direction. If they are an enemy, he deals {{as|magic damage}} to them at the end of the displacement.
params.description2: '''''Tahm Kench''' is {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} for {{fd|0.4}} seconds after casting Regurgitate. If Regurgitate was cast automatically, '''Tahm Kench''' spits the target out in his facing direction.''
params.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|100 to 400}} {{as|(+ 15% {{as|(+ 7% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
params.notes:
* The displacement from spitting the target out also uniquely counts as the enemy's {{tip|dash}}.
* The target will face in the direction of ''Regurgitate's'' cast for the duration of the displacement.
* The target will {{tip|blink}} to '''Tahm Kench's''' location at the start of ''Regurgitate's'' cast time.
* ''Regurgitate'' will also automatically cast if the target is affected by {{ai|Fate's Call|Kalista}} or enters {{tip|resurrection}}.

blurb.plain: Active: Tahm Kench spits the swallowed champion in the target direction. If they are an enemy, he deals magic damage based on the target's maximum health.

description.plain: Active: Tahm Kench detaches the swallowed champion from himself and spits them out in the target direction. If they are an enemy, he deals magic damage to them at the end of the displacement.

description2.plain: Tahm Kench is unable to act for 0.4 seconds after casting Regurgitate. If Regurgitate was cast automatically, Tahm Kench spits the target out in his facing direction.
